deploy.startCommand: echo '[boot] 1/4 migrate' && npx prisma migrate deploy && echo '[boot] 2/4 admin' && (npm run set:admin || echo '[boot] set:admin skipped (무시하고 계속)') && echo '[boot] 3/4 templates' && (if [ "$SEED_TEMPLATES" = "1" ]; then npm run db:templates || echo '[boot] templates 실패(무시)'; else echo '[boot] SEED_TEMPLATES!=1 — 건너뜀'; fi) && echo '[boot] 4/4 start' && npm run start
